annis totidem virorum collegium terti-
um, cui cura demandata est bonorum

us ad collegium primum pertinebat.
Causa instituti hujus fuit, quòd crede-
re-tur, collegium primum rebus omnibus,
quæ illi commissæ erant, non sufficere.
Sedent in eo duo à senatu oppidano dati

comitiis. Curatio eorum annua, nisi fiat
prorogatio, quæ fit sæpè. Duo ex his, al-
ter ex oppidanis ex agrariis alter, actorum
& rationum indices aut libros tenentur
conficere, capiuntque stipendium è pu-
blico Carolinos aureos ccc; cæteri verò

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment ("fis,") continuing from the previous page; the first letter of "ctis" is partly covered by the line end and is read as "ctis" (probably infra-ctis). The marginal "cc" marks are read as printed; their function is unclear. Print appears slightly blurred in the lower right, with digitiser text ignored.
